policy.production_rule: Only content merged to canonical main is production source unless an immutable source commit is explicitly pinned for a physical or compatibility gate.
policy.open_pr_rule: Open pull requests and their branches are candidates, not production source.
policy.closed_unmerged_rule: Closed unmerged pull requests are provenance/superseded records unless explicitly named otherwise.
policy.history_rule: Historical branches and superseded scripts remain available through Git history; source cleanup must preserve provenance and must not erase evidence, failed states, or superseded states.
policy.external_project_rule: Physics and external product work in this repository is not Automation runtime source unless separately promoted through an Automation integration decision.
policy.file_library_rule: A File Library artifact is not a fresh-phone canonical module until exact complete bytes are published to an immutable source and registered with validation metadata.
policy.control_plane_rule: Base44 and other connected services may hold coordination/evidence state but do not replace Git main as canonical software source.
policy.defer_and_continue_rule: When a work item hits a genuine external, credential, physical-device, authorization, platform, falsification, supersession, or negative-value boundary, record the blocker and resume condition in automation/DEFERRED_BLOCKERS.json, skip that item, and continue independent eligible work without promoting the blocked state.

canonical_deferred_blockers.resume_rule: Resume a deferred item only when its recorded resume condition becomes observable; otherwise leave it deferred and continue independent work.
canonical_deferred_blockers.promotion_boundary: Deferred or blocked work is never promoted by substitution, inference, host-only evidence, or queue presence.

canonical_physical_gate.acceptance_rule: Issue #208 Phase A and Phase B are the current physical acceptance path; legacy issue #64/RC9/finalizer paths are provenance/compatibility only.

canonical_runtime.pipeline: Intent -> Authorization -> Event/Queue -> Capability Selection -> Bounded Execution -> Verification -> Evidence/Audit -> State Update -> Controlled Evolution

scientific_work_exclusion.rule: Physics/FToE and geometric-symbolic scientific PRs are research branches, not Automation runtime source unless explicitly integrated through a separate bounded integration PR.

legacy_source_policy.termux_versioned_scripts: Retain versioned scripts that are referenced by immutable registries, compatibility paths, tests, or provenance. Do not delete merely because a newer filename exists.
legacy_source_policy.old_branches: Do not treat old branches as current source; preserve them for Git provenance unless a separate branch-retention policy authorizes deletion.
legacy_source_policy.generated_artifacts: Generated ZIPs, test caches, device evidence, and local build outputs belong in artifact/evidence storage, not source control.
